APP.title: Directional Token Images
APP.prototypeScope: Saved on the actor — every new token inherits it
APP.propagate: Also update tokens already placed on scenes
APP.propagateHint: {count} token(s) across your scenes come from this actor and will be brought up to date.
APP.propagateNone: No tokens from this actor are placed on any scene yet.

enabled.label: Enable Directional Images
enabled.hint: Automatically swap this token's artwork based on the direction it moves in.

mode.label: Image Set
mode.hint: How many artwork variants this token uses. Images configured for other sets are kept, so switching back and forth is lossless.

mirrorHorizontal.label: Mirror left and right
mirrorHorizontal.hint: Let one side's drawing serve the other, flipped horizontally: fill in East and West is produced automatically (and vice versa). Diagonals pair up the same way. Only the sign of the token's horizontal scale is changed — never its magnitude, and never its rotation.

visionFacing.label: Vision cone follows the artwork
visionFacing.hint: Turn this token's vision and light cones to match the drawing it is wearing, so the blind wedge always sits behind it. Only does anything when the token's vision angle (or light angle) is narrower than 360°. "Follow world setting" uses the module setting of the same name.

default.label: Default / Fallback
default.hint: Used whenever the direction's own image is empty.

n.label: Up (North)
n.hint: Shown when the token moves away from the viewer.

ne.label: Up-Right (North-East)
ne.hint: Falls back to North or East when empty.

e.label: Right (East)
e.hint: Shown when the token moves to the right.

se.label: Down-Right (South-East)
se.hint: Falls back to South or East when empty.

s.label: Down (South)
s.hint: Shown when the token moves towards the viewer.

sw.label: Down-Left (South-West)
sw.hint: Falls back to South or West when empty.

w.label: Left (West)
w.hint: Shown when the token moves to the left.

nw.label: Up-Left (North-West)
nw.hint: Falls back to North or West when empty.

1.label: 1 image (standard)
1.hint: A single image. Behaves like an ordinary Foundry token.

2.label: 2 images (front / back)
2.hint: Front and back artwork, ideal for simple sprite sheets.

8.label: 8 images (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW)
8.hint: Full eight-direction artwork for detailed isometric tokens.

HINTS.notEnabled: Images are configured but "Enable Directional Images" is off, so nothing will change on the canvas.
HINTS.emptyKeepsCurrent: Leaving a direction empty keeps the token's current artwork instead of changing it. GIF and WEBM files are supported.
HINTS.transform: Position and scale only affect the artwork, never the token's grid footprint or its occupied squares.

defaultMode.name: Default image set
defaultMode.hint: The image set used by tokens configured to follow the world default.

directionProvider.name: Direction provider
directionProvider.hint: How movement is translated into a facing. Modules can register additional providers for custom projections.

angleOffset.name: Facing offset
angleOffset.hint: Rotates the detected direction by this many degrees before choosing an image. Useful for maps whose art is drawn on an angle.

sensitivity.name: Direction sensitivity
sensitivity.hint: Above 1 favours the cardinal directions, below 1 favours diagonals (and, in four-image mode, horizontal movement).

movementThreshold.name: Movement threshold
movementThreshold.hint: Minimum distance in pixels a token must move before its artwork may change.

updateDuringDrag.name: Update during drag
updateDuringDrag.hint: Swap the artwork live while a token is being dragged. The preview only, nothing is saved until the drag is released.

applyAfterMovement.name: Update only after movement ends
applyAfterMovement.hint: Wait for the movement animation to finish before swapping. Costs one extra update per move; leave off for the smoothest result.

smoothTransition.name: Smooth transition
smoothTransition.hint: Cross-fade between artwork instead of cutting instantly.

transitionType.name: Transition style
transitionType.hint: The visual effect used when the artwork changes.

transitionSpeed.name: Transition speed
transitionSpeed.hint: Duration of the artwork transition in milliseconds. Movement speed is never affected.

preloadTextures.name: Preload textures
preloadTextures.hint: Warm the texture cache when a scene loads so the first swap never stutters.

showHudButton.name: Show HUD button
showHudButton.hint: Add a direction control to the Token HUD for testing and manual overrides.

visionFollowsFacing.name: Vision cone follows the artwork
visionFollowsFacing.hint: Aim each directional token's vision and light cones along the direction its current drawing is facing, so the unseen wedge stays behind the character instead of in front of it. Only tokens whose vision angle (or light angle) is narrower than 360° are affected, and the facing is written together with Lock Rotation so the artwork itself never turns. Works on isometric maps: the facing is mapped back through whichever direction provider is active.

visionSelfRadius.name: Self-visibility circle
visionSelfRadius.hint: How much a steered token can always see around itself, whatever its cone is doing. Foundry sizes this from the token's grid footprint, which is far too small for isometric artwork drawn much taller than its square — a character walking towards the camera ends up with their own head inside their own blind spot. "Auto" measures the drawn artwork and covers exactly that, and is the right answer on any isometric map. Walls still block normally, and the cone itself is not changed by a single degree.

debug.name: Debug mode
debug.hint: Log detailed direction and swap information to the browser console.
